profile.headline: Software Developer at Liberty Mutual Insurance

positions.title: Financial Analyst
positions.description: Update, evaluate, and develop company budget and forecast using internal business models, this includes detailed financial statement analysis and cash flow analysis.  Liaised with external legal counsel and investors to secure $50mm financing.  Performed analysis on the company book to determine Policy Life Expectancy for various carriers.  Developed marketing reports, using SQL, to identify lead cost and performance from various vendors in different states.  Perform analysis on sales agent productivity to optimize agent behavior.  Report directly to CFO and perform ad hoc analysis for senior management.

positions.title: Risk Analyst
positions.description: Maintain, monitor, and validate deals, positions, open trade equity, settlements, and margin requirements for all exchange/cleared broker accounts.  Monitor positions against business, portfolio, product, strategy, and trader limits to ensure the company stays within established limits and authorizations per Corporate Policy & Procedures, exchange and clearing broker limits, and CFTC limits.  Developed core report for the options portfolio including delta equivalent volume limits, raw volume limits, Vega, V@R, premium limits, and portfolio stress limits.  Worked with trading to develop Real Time Bal-Day trading model.  Upload margin calculation rates into PC SPAN and analyzed margin requirements on new trading products.  Run reports and query information from the trade system, Endur (Open Link).

positions.title: Partner/Investment Analyst
positions.description: Perform analysis to determine high volume, low inventory residential real estate markets.  Identify acquisition candidates in target markets based on both quantitative and qualitative criteria.  Structure and manage short sale transactions between owners, lenders, brokers, negotiators, investors, and attorneys.  Determine acquisition and resale price that fits within risk limits.  Coordinate with contractors in the planning and execution of renovations for maximum profit.  Compile and organize all transaction documents and information for accounting and project postmortem analysis.

positions.title: Credit Analyst
positions.description: Provided credit risk analysis and support to enable access to wholesale and structured energy markets.  Determined counterparty creditworthiness through financial statement analysis, industry analysis, and legal entity structures.  Worked closely with the origination team to review terms of transactions and identified risk.  Initiated and negotiated commercial contracts including EEIs, ISDAs, and NAESBs.  Performed daily margin calls to track counterparty exposure.  Assisted in the maintenance and development of the credit risk system.

positions.title: Associate Quantitative Analyst
positions.description: Developed models to price energy derivatives, performed analysis of spot/forward prices and volatilities for making pricing and trading/risk management decisions.  Assisted the development of core models to support trading, origination, and asset optimization decisions.  Worked with origination, risk management, and trading departments to interpret valuations provided by models.  Responded to intra-day trading requests to price and evaluate structured transactions.  Developed risk management tools in evaluating company's risk profile and exposure levels.

company.name: FPL Energy Power Marketing, Inc. (Now NextEra)
